mapper.sql: FROM TB_LMS_USER A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID, MAX(UA.ORG_ID) AS ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA GROUP BY UA.USER_ID ) UAO ON UAO.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = UAO.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID , AU.AUTHRTNM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UA.USER_ID ORDER BY AU.AUTHRT_SEQ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM' ) ADM_AUTH ON ADM_AUTH.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND ADM_AUTH.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID , AU.AUTHRTNM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UA.USER_ID ORDER BY AU.AUTHRT_SEQ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM' ) USERTY_AUTH ON USERTY_AUTH.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND USERTY_AUTH.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT UA.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_CD = 'GUEST' ) GUEST_AUTH ON GUEST_AUTH.USER_ID = A.USER_ID

WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND UA.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND UA.AUTHRT_ID = #{authrtGrpcd} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID WHERE UA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID WHERE UA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND UA.AUTHRT_ID = #{userTycd} )
AND ( LOWER(A.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchValue}) || '%' OR LOWER(A.USERNM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchValue}) || '%' OR LOWER(A.STDNT_NO) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchValue}) || '%' )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.selectUserMgr 설 명 : 사용자 단건 조회 (수정 폼) */ SELECT A.USER_ID , UAO.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , A.USERNM , A.USER_TYCD , A.AC_RCD_TYCD , A.STDNT_NO , A.DSBL_TYCD , A.DSBL_GRDCD , A.SNRYN , A.DSBLYN , A.PHOTO_FILE_ID , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS mobileNo , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS email FROM TB_LMS_USER A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID, MAX(UA.ORG_ID) AS ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA GROUP BY UA.USER_ID ) UAO ON UAO.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = UAO.ORG_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}
/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.countUserMgrId 설 명 : 사용자 아이디 중복 건수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.insertUserMgr 설 명 : 사용자 등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_LMS_USER ( USER_ID , USERNM , USER_TYCD , STDNT_NO , AC_RCD_TYCD , DSBL_TYCD , DSBL_GRDCD , SNRYN , DSBLYN , PHOTO_FILE_ID , USER_ID_ENCPSWD , USER_ID_APLY_DTTM , USER_ID_APRV_DTTM , LGN_MTHD_GBNCD , AUTO_LGN_USEYN , USE_EML_GBNCD , USER_STSCD , USER_ID_STSCD , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{userId} , #{usernm} , #{userTycd} , #{stdntNo} , #{acRcdTycd} , #{dsblTycd} , #{dsblGrdcd} , NVL(#{snryn}, 'N') , NVL(#{dsblyn}, 'N') , #{photoFileId} , #{userIdEncpswd} , FN_DTTM() , SUBSTR(FN_DTTM(), 1, 8) || '000000' , 'IDPWD' , 'N' , 'INDV' , 'ACTV' , 'APRV_CMPTN' , #{rgtrId} , FN_DTTM() , #{mdfrId} , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.countUserGuestAuthrt 설 명 : 대상 사용자의 손님(AUTHRT_CD='GUEST') 권한 보유 건수 조회 (탈퇴 대상 검증) */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AU ON AU.AUTHRT_ID = UA.AUTHRT_ID AND AU.AUTHRT_CD = 'GUEST' WHERE UA.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.listAdminGbn 설 명 : 관리자 구분(AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM') 권한 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID , A.AUTHRTNM , A.AUTHRT_GRPCD FROM TB_LMS_AUTHRT A WHERE A.USEYN = 'Y' AND A.LANG_CD = 'KO' AND A.AUTHRT_GRPCD = 'ADM' ORDER BY A.AUTHRT_SEQ

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.listUserGbn 설 명 : 사용자 구분(AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM') 권한 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID , A.AUTHRTNM , A.AUTHRT_GRPCD FROM TB_LMS_AUTHRT A WHERE A.USEYN = 'Y' AND A.LANG_CD = 'KO' AND A.AUTHRT_GRPCD != 'ADM' ORDER BY A.AUTHRT_SEQ
/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.listUserAuthrtId 설 명 : 사용자가 보유한 권한 ID 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.selectAuthrt 설 명 : 권한 단건 조회 (권한코드/권한명/권한그룹) - 권한변경이력 적재용 */ SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID , A.AUTHRT_CD , A.AUTHRTNM , A.AUTHRT_GRPCD FROM TB_LMS_AUTHRT A WHERE A.AUTHRT_ID = #{authrtId} AND A.LANG_CD = 'KO'

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDAO.listUserTelnoChgHstry 설 명 : 사용자전화번호변경이력 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY H.CHG_DTTM DESC) AS RNUM , ORG.ORGNM , H.DGRS_YR , H.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , H.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , H.CHGBFR_MBL_TELNO , H.CHGAFT_MBL_TELNO , H.CHG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_USER_TELNO_CHG_HSTRY H JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = H.ORG_ID WHERE H.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY H.CHG_DTTM DESC
